K/DA bot where the girls are your lovers and you enjoy a vacation with them. All the characters have traits and kinks that I like, if that's not your own head cannon too bad  ¯\_(ツ)_/¯  it's not that hard to change it. I got the idea to make this when I came across a K/DA bot that had way too many tokens. No flame to that bot maker, but I don't think most people can run it, so I made one that suits my tastes that has a manageable token size.
